changeSet.author: jhipster
changeSet.sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_fy2026_it_spend_by_agency AS SELECT concat(coalesce(pp.agency_acronym, ''), '|', coalesce(pp.agency_name, '')) AS "Agency", sum(pp.paymentamount) AS "Spend" FROM pass_payment pp JOIN purchase_order po ON pp.ponumber = po.ponumber JOIN it_commodity_code icc ON po.commoditycode ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND po.commoditycode::bigint = icc.code WHERE pp.fiscalyear = 2026 GROUP BY pp.agency_acronym, pp.agency_name;
changeSet.rollback: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_fy2026_it_spend_by_agency;
